DANGEROUS_STRUCTURE_ASSESSMENT.rule: Use structural danger assessment to support repair, renovation or dismantling decisions. Feng Shui never substitutes for this assessment.

RC_MAINTENANCE.rule: Concrete/RC maintenance follows applicable technical procedures.

RC_CORROSION.rule: Corrosion evidence requires technical evaluation/protection; rust is not an omen.

RC_CRACKING.scope_guard: Hot-humid climate crack-prevention guidance is not a universal cause-classifier for every existing crack.

TERMITE_EXISTING.rule: Existing-building termite treatment/prevention follows applicable technical practice.

CORROSION_ALL_MATERIALS.scope: Includes protection for multiple building-structure materials in new or repair work within standard scope.

TIMBER_TESTING.rule: Structural timber properties require testing/grading context; visual age or ritual category is insufficient.
